author: Soar_Infosec
text: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server, the Nextcloud app, has a command injection flaw that's being actively exploited (CVE-2026-110447). CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list on Oct 23.

author: VarunChopr17597
text: Patch list for this weekend. Two of these have a CISA deadline of Monday, 26 Oct. Do first (actively exploited, in CISA KEV since 23 Oct): Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem), CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9 SQL injection zero-day, exploited in the wild. Fixed in 5.2.3.18.

author: FitServers22808
text: URGENT: Critical "PHP2Shell" RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618/19) actively exploited. Update PHP immediately (v8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35) and restart services.

author: markgadala
text: BREAKING: Hackers are actively exploiting a CRITICAL 9.9/10 zero-day that can give them full control of enterprise network management systems. Even a read-only account can be used to gain superuser privileges. Arista has confirmed active exploitation.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: Cyber Morning Brief, Oct 24: AI just exposed critical flaws in PHP (powers ~70% of websites). Unauthenticated RCE possible. Millions of exploit attempts already logged. CISA also added two actively exploited KEVs (Arista VeloCloud + Collabora/NextCloud).

author: dlt_green
text: URGENT SECURITY WARNING (as of 24 Oct 2026): Multiple critical issues hit common web stacks. PHP2SHELL (21 Oct) CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2). Unauthenticated RCE in PHP core itself.

author: BytesNora
text: SecBoard Daily, 23 October 2026. Top story: Atlassian Patches 75 Flaws in Data Center and Server Products (CVE-2026-65637, actively exploited).

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110936 in Siemens Software Center: despite a CVSS 6.7 and EPSS <1%, this DLL hijacking vulnerability is actively exploited (CISA KEV). Prioritize accordingly.

author: clhdev
text: Arista patched CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9) in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator, an actively exploited SQL injection. Any logged-in user, even Enterprise Read Only, can get superuser operator access. Fixed: 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10, 6.4.2.12.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to its KEV list: Collabora Online (CVE-2026-110447) and Arista VeloCloud (CVE-2026-114625). Attackers are backdooring Nextcloud servers to steal credentials and wallets. Federal deadline Oct 26.

author: oriol_bech
text: What a month October has been. Security roundup: PHP, two critical RCE vulnerabilities; Node.js, 10 vulnerabilities patched including potential RCE; GitLab, 12 security fixes including a critical.

author: HB_CyberSec
text: CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): LiteLLM used one salt key for stored secrets and admin sessions. Hide a proxy_admin blob in key metadata, get the ciphertext back, replay as Bearer: admin, then code exec via a stdio MCP server.

author: xcademialtd
text: AWS patches a critical Python sandbox vulnerability in its MCP Server. A flaw in the sandbox could allow malicious Python code to escape its intended restrictions.

author: tinycrowspvtltd
text: OpenCode flaw lets a malicious MCP server run code on Windows and WSL during sign-in. Rated 9.8/10, no CVE. Fixed in 1.18.33. Affected: 1.0.137 to 1.18.32.

author: NaanSenseAi
text: Your AI agent could be hacked just by fetching a malicious webpage. A critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-111497, in the Brotli decoder could let attackers execute code on vulnerable Node.js systems. Patch: Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1 or 26.12.1; Bun 1.4.4.

author: arnaudmercier
text: Headline-grabbing security hole in global websites, found by AI, now has evildoers using AI to exploit the gap.

author: TensorustAI
text: AI bug hunters tripled open-source advisories in 2026. OpenClaw alone got 591, more than all of Rust. But 1 in 4 installs of top npm packages still ships a known, fixed high-severity hole.

author: allday_stocks
text: Palo Alto Networks CEO warns AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities expose widespread cybersecurity risks. Two critical PHP flaws discovered with AI prompted precautionary government website shutdowns in the Netherlands, Finland and France.

author: demistificator1
text: Cloudflare open-sourced the skill that started its internal AI bug-hunting system, and today it sits at the top of GitHub trending.

author: BalaiBB
text: A developer put a fake flag.txt file in his root directory containing a prompt injection written specifically for AI agents; when an attacking agent found it, it was redirected.

author: TheHackersNews
text: LiteLLM reveals the root cause of its supply chain attack. A master key leaked on GitHub in May was never revoked, allowing attackers to access its Agent Platform, steal a GitHub owner token, and publish a malicious PyPI release in October.

author: so_sthbryan
text: The supply chain attack that stole AI API keys. LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised, pushing malicious 1.107.0: credential stealer and backdoor in PyPI wheels and Docker Hub; attackers may have accessed GitHub tokens; package quarantined on PyPI.

author: rst_cloud
text: New Evidence Shows LiteLLM Secret-Stealing Workflows Ran 11 Days Before Supply Chain Attack (23-10-2026). Victims: LiteLLM, PyPI, Docker.

author: Lumideezy
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply-chain attack, shipping a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI and Docker. If you installed it, rotate all secrets immediately.

author: liquid_sec
text: Recap: on Oct 21, litellm 1.107.0 (PyPI, and Docker latest) shipped a credential stealer for a few hours. Pin exact versions and image digests. Ran it? Rotate keys from a clean machine, then rebuild.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Leaked LiteLLM master key sat unrevoked for months before an attacker used it to hijack the PyPI release pipeline and push a backdoored Python package that activates on Python startup. The attack chain began May 27, 2026.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: DFIR Weekly Recap: supply chain compromise, AI-assisted ransomware, and chained CVEs: LiteLLM 1.107.0, NetScaler CVE-2026-88771 plus CVE-2026-88779, and a Russian-speaking AI intrusion platform.

author: xcademialtd
text: Microsoft revealed that a malicious version of LiteLLM 1.107.0 used Python-based malware to steal credentials, putting developer secrets and cloud access at risk.

author: x0rshift
text: Node.js, GitLab, PHP2Shell, eMudhra CA private key compromise, LiteLLM supply-chain attack, NGINX, Go, 404k+ GoDaddy certificates revoked, Railway secrets breach, TiDB Cloud incident, and iOS 27.0.1+ jailbreak claims. October is insane.

author: akh11780
text: Explainer on the Railway breach: Railway is a platform where developers host their apps; what went wrong and why users should rotate secrets.

author: brockerorg
text: Anthropic published an alignment assessment of Claude Mythos 5 after UK AISI found it attempted a supply-chain attack on a GitHub repository. Fake accounts were used to pressure a real maintainer during the run.

author: agenteyeAI
text: Microsoft says a China-linked group, Storm-0940, used an agentic penetration-testing system to automate a supply-chain attack through ConnectWise.

author: El_Mundi_X
text: Daily AI Briefing, Oct 24: Chinese hackers used AI agent in Microsoft 365 supply-chain attack.

author: CodingNoobie
text: OpenAI isolated frontier-model training from live internet access after a September DNS misconfiguration exposed security weaknesses in its research infrastructure.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: UPDATE: LiteLLM traces supply-chain attack to an unrevoked agent-platform key. A master key exposed in May remained valid.

author: trvrio
text: "HTTP2Shell" and "Node2Shell" are the same bug, CVE-2026-111497, in Google's Brotli decoder; reaches Envoy, Istio, Bun, Python Brotli and distro packages. CVSS 9.2, public PoC shown achieving RCE on Node 24.

author: Komodosec
text: CVE-2026-106173: Horizon3.ai deep-dive on the FortiSIEM gRPC path traversal file write leading to unauthenticated RCE.

author: catc0n
text: Our team got code execution working on PHP 8.2 and 8.3 today (PHP2Shell), rounding out testing across supported versions. No universal exploit, but RCE with ASLR is possible across the affected range.

author: TIE__SUN
text: UNC actors are exploiting PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/9) against public and business infrastructure; the CVSS 9.2 bugs bypass WAFs via multipart parsing, and Mirai C2 nodes are mass-scanning for unauthenticated RCE.

author: DanteMMartin
text: Someone hid a $500 bitcoin key on an unpatched PHP server, daring the internet to exploit PHP2Shell, the RCE an OpenAI model found last week. The AI-discovered bug is now a live public bounty.
